about: The smallest shock that breaches the reserve floor under the selected policy (T21). A search, not a forecast: no probability is attached, and the search cohort is stored apart and never mixed into the policy comparison. Each family is searched one at a time on top of a baseline: an exact integer binary search over its size (minor units, hours or basis points), on a rules-replay world where the other actors' reactions are replayed from the selected branch's transcript (an observation that no longer matches falls back to no_action and sets reactions_frozen). A coarse grid of 8 points checks monotonicity first. One fresh branch at the found point confirms it. LF-1 + LF-2, selected policy integrated, from round 0. USD minor units.
label: search result, not a forecast
size_bps: floor(breaking_size * 10000 / scale); the smallest shock of a baseline is the family with the lowest size_bps; ties keep the family order below
